updated.text: EUD Composition Guidance Addendum 2.0 Draft 1.0 The CSfC EUD Composition Guidance Addendum 2.0 Draft 1.0 defines requirements and guidance for implementing hardware separated EUDs within MA, CWLAN, and DAR CPs.  The following portions of these CPs will be updated by this addendum:  EUD provisioning, multiple security-level requirements, incorporating Retransmission Device Protection Profile requirements, Dedicated Outer (device) requirements and different deployment options for hardware separated EUDs.  This document is currently a draft document that is subject to change; any changes to this addendum will result in updates to all CSfC CPs which deal with EUDs. Download: EUD Composition Guidance Addendum 2.0 Draft 1.0 Please send comments to the Wi-Fi@nsa.gov alias.
